text:
Alex: Heads up — after the v2 rollout today we saw a subtle latency divergence in the canary vs baseline. Can we talk about adding a 'Canary Insights' view that makes this quick to triage? Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/console/snap/abc123 :eyes:
Priya: Short answer: yes. Need p50/p95, request rate, 95th error percent, and request-weighted traffic slice breakdowns. Also show baseline overlay and traffic split timeline.
Jordan: +1. Also want a per-route delta column and quick link to the trace sample. We should show rolling-window statistical test (e.g., Welch's t or bootstrapped CI) instead of raw %.
Marta: Agree. Current alerts flip on transient blips. Can we add a cooldown and require sustained delta for 3 windows? Maybe 5m windows x 3 consecutive.
Alex: Proposed alert proto (PromQL-ish):
```
# canary latency delta
rate(quantile_over_time(0.95, api_latency_seconds{env="canary"}[5m])) - rate(quantile_over_time(0.95, api_latency_seconds{env="baseline"}[5m])) > 0.15
```
Need also to limit to traffic slices where canary traffic > 1%.
Priya: For UI, allow filtering by: model, route, client-id, and tag (e.g., 'batch', 'low-latency'). UI should show percent traffic for each slice and ability to mute slices.
Jordan: For drilldown UX: click a metric -> expand to day view, compare same-time previous deploy, and show raw samples with jitter plot. Also include 'attribution' column: which feature flag or routing policy sent traffic.
Marta: Runbook note: If canary latency p95 climbs >20% for 15m, auto-scale dedicated pool and open a rollback ticket (manual rollback default).
sre-bot: [automated] canary-check failed for rollout/2026-03-18-23: reason=latency-p95: +22% in 3 windows. See /incidents/rollout-452
Alex: OK sounds actionable. Jordan — can you prototype the UI card? Priya — can you iterate on the alert thresholds & stats? I'll schedule a 30min sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Jordan: On it. Drafting a mock and a PromQL -> SQL translation for our OLAP store.
Priya: I'll run historical backtests against last 6 rollouts to tune cooldowns. Will post results.
Marta: I'll update the runbook and add the 'sustained' check to the alert policy. :white_check_mark:
